GRO reference: *** 1845, June quarter, THE HOLBORN UNION - Volume 02, page 149 ***
what it settles: *** THE SPELLING CONTROL AND A REAL FIND AT ONCE. *** The query said BRAYLEY and the index returned BRAILEY, which is what makes the nulls below trustworthy. *** AND HE SETTLES THREE THINGS. *** (1) *** THE TREE'S 22 JUNE 1845 IS RIGHT *** - a June birth falls in the June quarter - and the 1900 death index, which gave his age as 53 and implied 1847, had a careless informant, exactly as this archive concluded from the 1851 census. (2) *** THE BIRTHPLACE DISPUTE RESOLVES TO NEITHER SIDE: *** the census says ST PANCRAS and the tree says ST PAUL'S, and the registration district is *** HOLBORN *** - which is where his sister ISABELLA was born, recorded in 1861 as "London (City), ST ANDREW", that is St Andrew Holborn. (3) *** HIS MIDDLE NAME IS WALKER. ***
